arxiv-2209-04188.title: Differentially Private Stochastic Gradient Descent with Low-Noise
arxiv-2209-04188.creator: Puyu Wang, Yunwen Lei, Yiming Ying, Ding-Xuan Zhou
arxiv-2209-04188.description: Abstract Modern machine learning algorithms aim to extract fine-grained information from data to provide accurate predictions, which often conflicts with the goal of privacy protection. This paper addresses the practical and theoretical importance of developing privacy-preserving machine learning algorithms that ensure good performance while preserving privacy.

arxiv-2212-14721.title: Every Combinatorial Polyhedron Can Unfold with Overlap
arxiv-2212-14721.creator: Joseph O’Rourke
arxiv-2212-14721.description: Abstract Ghomi proved that every convex polyhedron could be stretched via an affine transformation so that it has an edge-unfolding to a net [ Gho14 ] . A net is a simple planar polygon; in particular, it does not self-overlap.

arxiv-2410-03022.title: Uncovering the New Accessibility Crisis in Scholarly PDFs Conference: The 26th International ACM SIGACCESS Conference on Computers and Accessibility; October 27–30, 2024; St. John’s, NL, Canada The 26th International ACM SIGACCESS Conference on Computers and Accessibility (ASSETS ’24), October 27–30
arxiv-2410-03022.creator: Anukriti Kumar, Lucy Lu Wang
arxiv-2410-03022.description: Abstract . Most scholarly works are distributed online in PDF format, which can present significant accessibility challenges for blind and low-vision readers. To characterize the scope of this issue, we perform a large-scale analysis of 20K open- and closed-access scholarly PDFs published between 2014–2023 sampled across broad fields of study.

arxiv-2411-00585.title: Fairness Testing of Large Language Models in Role-Playing
arxiv-2411-00585.creator: Xinyue Li, Zhenpeng Chen, Jie M. Zhang, Ying Xiao, Tianlin Li, Weisong Sun, Yang Liu, Yiling Lou, Xuanzhe Liu
arxiv-2411-00585.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Xinyue Li, Zhenpeng Chen, Jie M. Zhang, Ying Xiao, Tianlin Li, Weisong Sun, Yang Liu, Yiling Lou, Xuanzhe Liu. Large Language Models (LLMs) have become foundational in modern language-driven software applications, profoundly influencing daily life. A critical technique in leveraging their potential is role-playing, where LLMs simulate diverse roles to enhance their real-world utility. However, while research has highlighted the presence of social biases in LLM outputs, it remains unclear whether and to what extent these biases emerge during role-playing scenarios.

arxiv-2411-10096.title: Neural Port-Hamiltonian Models for Nonlinear Distributed Control: An Unconstrained Parametrization Approach
arxiv-2411-10096.creator: Muhammad Zakwan, Giancarlo Ferrari-Trecate
arxiv-2411-10096.description: Abstract The control of large-scale cyber-physical systems requires optimal distributed policies relying solely on limited communication with neighboring agents. However, computing stabilizing controllers for nonlinear systems while optimizing complex costs remains a significant challenge. Neural Networks (NNs), known for their expressivity, can be leveraged to parametrize control policies that yield good performance.

arxiv-2501-01782.title: Chemistry in the Galactic Center
arxiv-2501-01782.creator: Izaskun Jiménez-Serra1
arxiv-2501-01782.description: Abstract Gas and dust in the Galactic Center are subjected to energetic processing by intense UV radiation fields, widespread shocks, enhanced rates of cosmic-rays and X-rays, and strong magnetic fields. The Giant Molecular Clouds in the Galactic Center present a rich chemistry in a wide variety of chemical compounds, some of which are prebiotic.

arxiv-2507-08196.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning in Applied Control: Challenges, Analysis, and Insights Journal: xxx
arxiv-2507-08196.creator: Klinsmann Agyei, Pouria Sarhadi, Daniel Polani
arxiv-2507-08196.description: Abstract Over the past decade, remarkable progress has been made in adopting deep neural networks to enhance the performance of conventional reinforcement learning. A notable milestone was the development of Deep Q-Networks (DQN), which achieved human-level performance across a range of Atari games, demonstrating the potential of deep learning to stabilise and scale reinforcement learning.

arxiv-2512-19714.title: Onsager’s Real Cavity model near solid interfaces
arxiv-2512-19714.creator: Johannes Fiedler, Drew F. Parsons
arxiv-2512-19714.description: Abstract We develop an extended Onsager real-cavity framework to describe the Casimir–Polder interaction of small molecules dissolved in dielectric liquids near planar interfaces. By analytically resolving the geometry of the cavity opening, we derive a closed expression that arise when the molecule approaches a surface and connect them smoothly to the asymptotic medium-assisted interaction.

pmc-10696788.title: Effects of combined aerobic exercise and diet on cardiometabolic health in patients with obesity and type 2 diabetes: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-10696788.creator: Sameer Badri Al-Mhanna, Sílvia Rocha-Rodriguesc, Mahaneem Mohamed, Alexios Batrakoulis, Monira I Aldhahi, Hafeez Abiola Afolabi, Fatma Hilal Yagin, Maha H Alhussain, Mehmet Gülü, Bishir Daku Abubakar, Wan Syaheedah Wan Ghazali, Abdullah F Alghannam, Georgian Badicu

pmc-11388154.title: Pressure-induced superconductivity domes described with a theoretical equation based on the free volume concept
pmc-11388154.creator: Tian Hao
pmc-11388154.description: SummaryA generic conductivity equation developed in our previous work is borrowed to explore how superconductivity transition temperature Tc changes with external high pressure. The volume-pressure relationship revealed in the literature is utilized to estimate the pressure-dependent free volume based on our free volume equation. Pressure-induced single and double superconductivity domes are predicted with the obtained equation.

pmc-11496035.creator: Xiaoli Xu, Mancheng Zhang, Siyuan Zhan, Yuan Chen, Chengqi Wei, Jiaxue Cao, Jiazhong Guo, Dinghui Dai, Linjie Wang, Tao Zhong, Hongping Zhang, Li Li

pmc-12618821.description: H syndrome, a rare autosomal recessive disorder, is caused by pathogenic variants in the SLC29A3 gene located on chromosome 10q22. A strain isolated from chicken intestines in China was selected as a representative for in-depth analysis of the genetic background and potential functional properties. pmc-13344905.title: Beyond Burnout: Rebuilding Medical Professionalism in Europe's Overstretched Health Systems
pmc-13344905.creator: Gian Marco Rizzuti
pmc-13344905.description: Medicine in Europe is undergoing a profound cultural and structural transition. Public debate often describes the current crisis in terms of burnout, workforce shortages, generational change, or financial pressure. Although these factors are important, they do not fully explain the erosion of professional satisfaction, clinical confidence, and institutional trust among physicians.

pmc-13474428.creator: Patrick Outhwaite
pmc-13474428.description: SummaryWhile travelling across Europe, Jan of Jenštejn, archbishop of Prague (1379–96; d. 1400) suffered many illnesses.
